title: Quotient-remainder compositional embedding Mirror address
hypothesis: For a collision-free quotient/remainder vocabulary whose embeddings lie on a unit-circle orbit over two complementary table rows, one token-specific Givens coordinate can recover vector/task quality while using materially fewer complete inference bytes than independent embeddings and direct two-coefficient composition, and improve over fixed addition, multiplication, and concatenation-projection operators.
physical_object: Two fixed shared 32x16 component tables indexed by q=floor(token/32) and r=token mod 32; every one of 1024 token IDs has a unique quotient/remainder pair.
mirror_coordinate: One learned angle theta_i per token; E_i=cos(theta_i)Q[q_i]+sin(theta_i)R[r_i]. The angle code is the only trained Mirror-specific state; component tables are fixed and charged.
logical_multiplicity: 1024 distinct token embedding functions represented by two shared complementary 32x16 tables plus one angle coordinate per token.
prior_art_delta: PA59 quotient-remainder/complementary partitions provide unique addresses and compact factor tables. This experiment holds the address and component tables fixed and tests whether a small learned functional coordinate over the two addressed rows beats fixed addition/product/concatenation-projection while compressing the two native free coefficients per token.

model.hashing: none; exact quotient and remainder address, no address collisions
methods: concatenation followed by a fixed seeded 32x16 projection
shared quotient/remainder tables plus two learned direct coefficients per token
shared quotient/remainder tables plus one learned Mirror Givens angle per token

teacher.tables: Seeded fixed shared Q and R component matrices are paid in every compositional method and are not optimized.
teacher.embedding: For each token, a seeded teacher angle generates E_i=cos(theta_i)Q[q_i]+sin(theta_i)R[r_i]. This is a deliberately aligned coordinate-feasibility fixture.
teacher.task_quality: A fixed seeded 16x16 decoder maps the teacher embedding to one of 16 classes; labels are frozen and shared across methods. Report embedding NRMSE, decoder NLL and top-1 accuracy.
teacher.address_audit: Report number of unique (q,r) pairs and prove zero address collisions.

development.selection_metric: Embedding NRMSE is primary; decoder NLL/top-1, complete serialized payload bytes, unique-address count, and active compute/wall time are secondary.
development.allowed_tuning: No tuning planned. Tables, teacher, projection, optimizer, schedule and seeds are fixed. Correctness fixes may rerun development only before fresh access.

fresh.open_gate: Both development worlds: full and direct-coefficient embedding NRMSE <=0.03; Mirror NRMSE <=0.03 and decoder NLL within 0.02 nat/top-1 within 1pp of direct coefficients; Mirror complete payload <=0.60x full embedding; Mirror beats each fixed addition/product/concat-projection NRMSE by >=0.01 at <=1.10x each payload; Mirror matches direct coefficients within 0.005 NRMSE while using <=0.90x their actual payload; all 1024 addresses unique and exact serialized replay. Otherwise fresh stays sealed.
fresh.fresh_success: All three fresh worlds meet the same quality, fixed-composition margin, direct-coefficient bytes and full-table bytes gates with exact payload/metric replay.

storage.authority: actual compressed NPZ inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: independent embedding table or both shared quotient/remainder component tables
each token's two direct coefficients or Mirror angle
concat projection matrix and its seed for the concatenation control
vocabulary/table dimensions, method metadata, serialization names and archive overhead
storage.deterministic_reconstruction: Quotient/remainder addresses are derived exactly from token ID and table dimensions. No learned address list is stored.

success_gate: All development and fresh quality, fixed-operator margin, direct-coefficient bytes, full-table bytes, uniqueness and exact-replay criteria pass.
failure_gate: Any frozen development gate fails, or Mirror is matched by direct coefficients/fixed operators within thresholds without the required byte reduction.
boundaries: aligned synthetic quotient/remainder embedding screen; not natural language or recommendation evidence
shared component tables are fixed to isolate code/composition representability, not end-to-end table learning
one fixed 16-class decoder is a proxy task and embedding NRMSE remains primary
fixed update budget is not a capacity or near-convergence claim
